inventory_replenishment_current_snapshot.landingEvidenceCondition: Admissible only for a claim explicitly scoped to the current cutoff. A current-snapshot verdict may never be presented as replay readiness.

eventPlacementRules: known_as_of >= fulfilled_at for every fulfillment line
known_as_of >= status_effective_at for every status observation

labelSemantics.blocked: A temporal-policy violation is present, such as a business-effective date promoted into availability. Reason code BUSINESS_DATE_AS_AVAILABILITY.
labelSemantics.note: Both set consumerMayProceed = false. The distinction must stay accurate in evidence and in the UI: one is missing evidence, the other is a rule violation.
labelSemantics.unavailable: Required evidence is absent or below the grade floor. Reason code EVIDENCE_GRADE_TOO_WEAK.

inventory_replenishment.retiredReason: One flag could not distinguish serviceable current-position analytics from unavailable origin-safe replay. Replaced by inventory_replenishment_current_snapshot and inventory_replenishment_replay.

capabilities.rule: Readiness and statistical sufficiency are separate fields. A capability that is ready may still be statistically insufficient, and validated_partial must stop before any consumer whose required capability is incomplete.
capabilities.splitRule: Each capability publishes independent readiness and sufficiency. A inventory_replenishment_current_snapshot verdict of ready never implies inventory_replenishment_replay readiness, and validated_partial or unavailable current analytics authorizes no replay. Both must be ready + sufficient before the inventory and replenishment destinations exit, because replay is an exit criterion rather than a bonus.

description: Which source evidence may establish that a fact was knowable at a model origin, and when a missing sale may become a zero-demand label. Ingestion success is never sufficient on its own.

native_extracted.meaning: an immutable snapshot or CDC extract time is the earliest defensible availability

native_observed.meaning: the source recorded the observation time

native_posted_available.meaning: a retained source posting rule proves availability

native_processed.meaning: the source recorded a deterministic processing-availability time

rules: A business-effective date may never be promoted into known_as_of.
A grade may not be upgraded to improve a capability verdict; it is derived from what the source supplies.
An unsupported derivation quarantines the row or downgrades the capability, never both silently.

supersedes.reason: Splits inventory_replenishment into an explicitly current-scoped capability and an origin-safe replay capability. v1 remains the policy every readiness verdict published before this was evaluated under.

conditions.requirement: the extract is complete for the whole business interval
SKU x store x channel was actively listed for the interval, from dated assortment evidence
the observation was knowable by the model fit cutoff
partial boundary-week exposure is handled under decision #56
no unresolved source gap or omitted channel applies

zeroDemand.description: A weekly zero-demand label is derived, not assumed. All conditions must hold; otherwise the cell is unknown, not zero.
forbidden: manufacturing historical zeros from a current catalog snapshot
treating an absent row as zero without assortment evidence
inferring assortment from the presence of sales
